subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata result field and server_error retry-before-failover ordering be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877?
rationale: The patch appears directionally right but changes retry/session semantics and adds a harness result field while multiple open PRs compete for the same bug.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require full-runner or gateway proof plus a clean merge against current main, then treat this as the canonical fix path.

options.title: Consolidate into another open PR
options.body: If https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 has the preferred proof or implementation shape, preserve this PR's useful tests there and close this later as superseded after a viable path is chosen.

options.title: Reject the new result field
options.body: Ask for a different same-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want to extend EmbeddedRunAttemptResult.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require full-runner or gateway proof plus a clean merge against current main, then treat this as the canonical fix path.

likelyOwner.reason: This account merged and validated the adjacent empty-error retry work and is the strongest routing candidate for the retry semantics decision.
